dedupe_keys.name: gisco healthcare services in europe hospital locations harmonised from national official sources with beds emergency service and public or private status reference years 2020 and 2023

description: This data set maps Europe's hospitals on one common schema, built from each country's official lists. It is produced by GISCO, the geographic information service of Eurostat, which retrieves national sources such as health ministry registers, harmonises them automatically and republishes them. Each hospital site has a national identifier where one exists, name, address, coordinates with a geolocation quality flag, whether it provides emergency services, capacity as beds, practitioners or rooms where reported, the national facility type, public or private status, recognised specialties and contact details, with reference and publication dates. Coverage is 31 countries, including EU Member States and Albania, Switzerland, Montenegro, Norway and Serbia, for reference years 2020 and 2023, plus an EU-wide file of about 14,000 sites. The files are free and available to download as CSV, GeoJSON or GeoPackage. Caveats: the definition of a hospital and the attributes filled in vary by country, the licence of several national sources is marked to be determined, and data may contain inconsistencies that Eurostat asks users to report. Simulation uses: pan-European exposure analysis of hospitals to floods, heat and earthquakes, locating emergency departments for response planning, and cross-border access modelling. Related records: the Spanish national hospital catalogue (data-spain-catalogo-nacional-hospitales) is one of the national sources of this kind, and Healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) is a global open alternative.
